top_signals.title: Tankers defy sharp escalation of Iranian attacks to keep crude oil flowing through Strait of Hormuz
top_signals.summary: Soaring freight rates are giving tankers a big financial incentive to run the gauntlet through the Strait of Hormuz.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: ExxonMobil Profits Double to $15.4 Billion
top_signals.summary: ExxonMobil reported $15.4 billion in third-quarter profit Friday, more than double its earnings a year earlier, with its Gulf Coast refineries running at full capacity and diesel prices doing the rest. The company earned $3.72 per share, or $4.23 on an adjusted basis, beating Wall Street's $4.08 estimate. Adjusted net income reached $17.5 billion, making it one of Exxon's most profitable quarters ever.
